ammonia.reason: Limited urea deamination and amino acid deamination after only 15 days ripening.

animal_barnyard.reason: p-cresol/indole from goat milk plus rind yeasts and natural flora under chestnut leaf.

bitter.reason: Low hydrophobic peptides from chymosin proteolysis, partly masked by lactic acidity.

blue_moldy.reason: Very low 2-heptanone/2-nonanone, no Penicillium roqueforti inoculation.

browning.reason: High moisture and depleted lactose after lactic fermentation limits Maillard on heating.

buttery.reason: Diacetyl/acetoin from citrate fermentation by Lactococcus lactis in raw-milk lactic curd.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Butanoic and hexanoic acids from goat-fat lipolysis by native lipase and Geotrichum.

creaminess.reason: High moisture plus raw goat fat and surface deacidification proteolysis gives creamy paste.

crumbliness.reason: Acid-demineralized lactic gel gives friable-chalky core that creams from rind inward.

firmness.reason: High moisture ~55% unpressed lactic gel, soft spoonable disc under leaf wrapping.

floral_honey.reason: Low 2-phenylethanol/phenylacetaldehyde from phenylalanine catabolism by rind yeasts.

fruity.reason: Ethyl butanoate/hexanoate from yeast esterification of free fatty acids with ethanol.

goaty.reason: Caproic/caprylic/capric and 4-methyloctanoic acids from goat-milk triglyceride lipolysis.

malty_nutty.reason: Low 3-methylbutanal/3-methylbutanol from leucine Strecker degradation during short aging.

melt.reason: Acid lactic curd with calcium-depleted casein softens but flows poorly on heating.

mushroom_earthy.reason: 1-octen-3-ol/1-octen-3-one from Geotrichum lipase/lipoxygenase plus damp chestnut leaf.

oil_off.reason: Moderate fat ~23% emulsified in hydrated protein network, little free oil on heating.

smoky.reason: No smoking; no guaiacol phenols, chestnut leaf contributes tannin-woody not smoke.

sour_vinegar.reason: Lactic plus acetic acids from mesophilic lactic fermentation, core pH ~5.1.

stretch.reason: No pasta-filata kneading, acid curd lacks intact micellar calcium for fiber formation.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Minimal methionine-derived sulfides, no curd cooking and short ripening.

sweet.reason: Little residual lactose, slight sweetness from glycerol and proline balanced by acidity.

umami.reason: Low glutamate from limited chymosin and plasmin proteolysis in young paste.
